rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something in a hurried manner.

example.english: I hurriedly finished breakfast and headed out.
example.traditional: 我急急忙忙噉食埋個早餐就出門口。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gap1 gap1 mong4 mong4 gam2 sik6 maai4 go3 zou2 caan1 zau6 ceot1 mun4 hau2

rows.note: Use this when the person is hurrying to do V because time is pressing or another obligation is imminent.

example.english: I’m hurriedly finishing this report because I have a meeting soon.
example.traditional: 我趕住做完呢份報告，陣間要開會。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gon2 zyu6 zou6 jyun4 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zan6 gaan1 jiu3 hoi1 wui2

rows.note: Choose this when the hurried manner also suggests fluster, panic, or disorganization.

example.english: I hurriedly rushed out the door in a fluster and forgot to bring my wallet.
example.traditional: 我慌慌張張噉衝出門口，連銀包都唔記得帶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 fong1 fong1 zoeng1 zoeng1 gam2 cung1 ceot1 mun4 hau2 lin4 ngan4 baau1 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3
